name: Mindfulness Coach
one_liner: Free VA app that teaches mindfulness step by step, with short lessons, 12 guided audio exercises, goals and reminders. No account.
best_for: Beginners who want a structured, free mindfulness course without ads or subscriptions
Veterans and others with PTSD or stress who want a gentle practice to add to treatment
People practising mindfulness skills learned in therapy
People who want a no-account app that keeps data on the phone
not_for: Anyone in crisis: call or text 988 (veterans press 1)
People looking for a large library of meditations, sleep stories or music
People who need treatment for PTSD, depression or anxiety: it supports care but doesn't replace it
short_description: A free, self-guided mindfulness course from the VA's National Center for PTSD, with lessons, guided audio and progress tracking.
long_description: Mindfulness Coach was made by the VA's National Center for PTSD for anyone who wants to learn and practise mindfulness. It offers a step-by-step training plan, short readings on what mindfulness is, 12 audio-guided exercises (with more available as free downloads), goal setting, progress tracking, reminders and crisis resources; it can log Apple Health mindful minutes. First released in 2014 and redesigned in 2018, it is free with no in-app purchases and needs no account, and what you enter stays on your phone. A 2024 pilot randomized trial in 173 veterans with PTSD found medium improvements in PTSD and depression symptoms among people who completed the study, but most participants dropped out (68%), so the results need confirming. The VA says it does not replace treatment.
patient_summary: Mindfulness Coach walks you through learning mindfulness, from short readings to guided audio exercises, and helps you set goals and practise regularly. It is free from the VA, needs no account, and your entries stay on your phone. You can use it on your own or alongside therapy.

pricing.notes: Free from the VA, with no ads or in-app purchases; extra exercises are free downloads.

privacy.notes: VA apps need no account and send no identifying data to VA or third parties; entries stay on your device (anonymous usage data is collected). Deleting the app removes your entries.

seo.title: Mindfulness Coach: Review & Pricing
seo.meta_description: Mindfulness Coach is a free, self-guided mindfulness training program from the VA with audio exercises and progress tracking.

faqs.q: How much does Mindfulness Coach cost?
faqs.a: Free. Prices were checked in October 2026 and can change, so confirm with Mindfulness Coach before you sign up.

faqs.q: Can Mindfulness Coach replace therapy or treatment?
faqs.a: No. Mindfulness Coach is a self-help tool that can support your wellbeing or work alongside therapy, but it doesn't diagnose or treat conditions. If you're in crisis, call or text 988 in the US.

faqs.q: Where can I use Mindfulness Coach?
faqs.a: Mindfulness Coach is available on iPhone and Android.
Progressive mindfulness program; 12 guided audio exercises; Goals and reminders; Mastery self-assessment.

clinical_trials.outcome: Among completers (19 app, 37 waitlist), medium effects on PTSD and depression symptoms; no change in psychosocial functioning; 68.4% attrition.
